# Section 3. Revocation of Legal Notice No. 127 of2004

The Umbutfo Swaziland Defence Force (Remuneration) Regulations, 2004 are hereby revoked. THUS DONE UNDER MY HAND AT LOZITH’EHLEZI ON THIS 18th DAY OF MAY, 2005.
